| Main stream (`subtype=0`) | Measured by the maintainer, 2026-09-29, ffprobe: HEVC (H.265) Main, 2304×1296, 20 fps, AAC-LC audio. Bitrate and keyframe spacing PENDING (check 2). |
| Keyframe interval | **PENDING** for both profiles; command below |

Consequences already implemented: `4587021` makes `FrameStamper` keep a missing, repeated or backwards PTS for diagnostics but stamp it `source_time_quality=none`. Identity and ages already came only from ingest (receive) time, so nothing trusts such a PTS as stream time. Regression: `test_unset_and_non_increasing_pts_at_stream_start_fall_back_to_receive_time`.

Consequences for later packages: the capture adapter (V2-05) selects only the video stream; v1's 640×480 `cv2.resize` is a no-op in size on this profile (still a copy); a 640×480 source gives a 640×640 letterboxed detector input 25 % padding **if** the engine is 640×640, which the pending binding check settles (audit "engine shape").

**Replay clips.** Private recordings and review images stay outside Git and are preserved unopened. Historical ffprobe record for the `one_person`/`room_static` source: 60.0 s, 901 frames, H.264 Main 640×480 at 54060/3601 fps with an AAC-LC 16 kHz mono track; historical `empty_room`: 455.6 s, 6,832 frames, H.264 Main 640×480 at 204960/13667 (≈15.00) fps, video only. Session 8's **USER-SUPPLIED FILENAME LISTING** reports `empty_room_2026-09-29_1613.mp4` and `two_people_doorway_60s_2026-09-29.mp4`, not `room_static_60s_2026-09-29.mp4`. No rename is performed/requested now; equivalence of the listed occupied file to the historical run source remains **UNRESOLVED**. ### Conflict: perception frame-rate target versus the substream (U12; decided for the demo by D22)

Guide ch. 22 sets **≥15 unique detected frames/s sustained "in the declared 1080p-input core profile"**, with **20–25 fps as a stretch target**. The measured substream is **640×480 at 15.01 fps**, so:

1. The stretch target cannot be reached from this profile: there are only ~15 unique frames/s to detect.
2. The 15 fps minimum equals the source rate, so any dropped frame fails it. It needs restating as a fraction of source frames for this profile.
3. The substream is not the "1080p-input" profile the gate names. The main stream is not yet measured.

Options (for the maintainer; nothing is chosen yet):

- **A. Substream only (640×480 at 15 fps) for the beta core profile.** Restate the gate as "every unique source frame is detected: ≥ 98 % of source frames at ≥ 14.7 fps sustained, p95 frame age within budget", with 20–25 fps not applicable. Cheapest decode and memory, and it matches the detector input. Risk: small faces at distance reduce identity quality (measure in V2-25).
- **B. Raise the substream frame rate in the camera's encoder settings** (if the camera offers 20/25 fps at 640×480). Keeps option A's costs and restores the stretch target. Needs the camera's encoder options (PENDING) and a re-measured bitrate.
- **C. Main stream for perception** (resolution and rate PENDING). Meets the "1080p-input" wording, and 20–25 fps may be possible. Costs: larger decode and buffers, probably H.265 (the `~/onvif_env` restructure hints at H.265 on the main stream), more letterbox/resize work, and browser codec risk.
- **D. Two profiles:** substream for detection and tracking, main stream for face crops, clips and live view. Best identity detail, but two upstream sessions, which guide ch. 7 requires to be counted and approved, plus cross-stream timestamp mapping.

**Decision (D22):** option A for the Oct 20 demo; everything else stays open until after the demo.

**Recommendation as proposed:** A for the Oct 20 demo and the first Gate B work, because it is the only measured profile and is enough for detection and tracking. Measure the main stream and the camera's encoder options (PENDING commands) before choosing the beta profile between A, B and D. Record the chosen profile and restated gate as a decision; changing it later is a documented gate adjustment (ch. 22) made before held-out evaluation.

### v1 runtime environment `~/onvif_env` (read-only diagnostics by Claude, 2026-09-29)

Run with `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1` so no files were written into the environment; nothing was installed or changed. Config files were not read.

| Item | Observed |
|---|---|
| `pyvenv.cfg` | `home = /usr/local/bin`, `include-system-site-packages = false`, `version = 3.10.14` |
| Interpreter | CPython 3.10.14 (GCC 13.3.0, built 2026-03-23), base prefix `/usr/local` |
| Extra `sys.path` | `site-packages/system-packages.pth` adds `/usr/lib/python3/dist-packages`, which holds the **system Python 3.12** packages. So `import gi` finds the 3.12 build and fails ("cannot import name '_gi'"). The flag above therefore does not isolate this venv. |
| Packages | numpy 2.2.6, torch 2.9.1 (built with CUDA 12.6, cuDNN 9.3, aarch64 wheel), torchvision 0.24.1, tensorrt 10.3.0, ultralytics 8.4.25, tensorflow 2.21.0, deepface 0.0.99, onnxruntime 1.23.2, requests 2.32.5, Flask 3.1.3, PyYAML 6.0.3, pydantic 2.12.5; pycuda absent |
| OpenCV | cv2 4.13.0 from the **pip wheels** `opencv-python` **and** `opencv-python-headless` 4.13.0.92, both installed. Build info: **GStreamer NO**, FFMPEG YES (bundled avcodec 59.37.100 / avformat 59.27.100), v4l2 YES, CUDA devices 0, baseline NEON FP16. |
| v1 capture backend | Follows from the build: `cv2.VideoCapture(RTSP_URL)` can only use the bundled FFmpeg, which decodes H.264 **on the CPU**. There is no NVDEC path in this environment. This is established from the build, not from a runtime trace. |
| GPU from this venv | Without a preload, `torch.cuda.is_available()` is **False** ("No CUDA GPUs are available") and building a TensorRT `Builder` **aborts the process** ("terminate called without an active exception"). With `LD_PRELOAD=/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/nvidia/libcuda.so.1`, torch reports `Orin`, capability (8, 7), and runs a tensor op; the TensorRT builder is created (`platform_has_fast_fp16` True). |

**Why: a desktop-GPU CUDA driver library shadows the Jetson one.** The Ubuntu package `libnvidia-compute-535` (535.309.01-0ubuntu0.24.04.1) installs `/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/libcuda.so.1`, which the loader finds before L4T's `/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/nvidia/libcuda.so.1` (package `nvidia-l4t-cuda`). Measured with `ctypes`: the 535 library reports driver API 12020 and `cuInit` returns 100 (`CUDA_ERROR_NO_DEVICE`), while the L4T library initialises, reports driver API 12060 and counts 1 device. `nvidia-smi` fails with "Driver/library version mismatch" for the same reason. apt history mentions the package on 2026-03-23 (`apt upgrade -y`) and 2026-06-13 (aptdaemon, a desktop updater); which transaction installed it was not determined.

- `~/onvif_env/bin/activate` works around this by exporting `LD_PRELOAD` of the L4T library. **Invoking `~/onvif_env/bin/python` directly, without `activate`, gets no GPU.** `start_sentinel.sh` does that, so v1's GPU use depends on the environment of the shell that ran the launcher. `llama-server` resolves `libcuda.so.1` the same way. Check 3 (run by Claude in session 3, below) confirmed both: without the preload, the TensorRT process crashes and llama-server silently runs on the CPU.
- For v2 live GPU runs: `LD_PRELOAD=/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/nvidia/libcuda.so.1 PYTHONPATH=src ~/onvif_env/bin/python …`.
- **How the package arrived (session 3, apt history in the release-upgrade logs):** during the 22.04 → 24.04 release upgrade on **2026-02-20**, apt replaced the Jetson `nvidia-cuda-dev` 6.2.1+b38 with Ubuntu's same-named package 12.0.146 (noble/multiverse). That pulled in `nvidia-cuda-toolkit` 12.0, `libcudart12`, `libnvidia-ml-dev` and `libnvidia-compute-535` as automatic dependencies. `nvidia-cuda-dev` and `nvidia-cuda` are marked manually installed.
- Handled by D27: preload for the demo; restore the Jetson packages after Oct 20 behind a restore point. Nothing was changed.

**Consequence for V2-05/V2-09 (U14).** No existing interpreter has both halves of the planned media path. `~/onvif_env` (3.10) has TensorRT 10.3 but no GStreamer in OpenCV and no importable `gi`. The system Python 3.12 imports `gi` with GStreamer 1.24.2 (`python3-gi` 3.48.2, `nvidia-l4t-gstreamer` 36.4.7 installed) but has no TensorRT bindings (not checked for a 3.12 wheel). **Decision for the demo (D24): option (c), software decode in `~/onvif_env`; the rest waits for V2-05 proper.** Options as recorded: (a) decode in a `gst-launch-1.0` subprocess (`nvv4l2decoder ! nvvidconv ! BGRx ! fdsink`) that any interpreter reads from a pipe, with no new Python dependencies; (b) a new, separate v2 runtime environment, never `~/onvif_env`; (c) interim CPU decode through `~/onvif_env`'s OpenCV for the Oct 20 demo only, labelled as such. Per the maintainer's rules, any new environment or dependency is proposed first.

### Check 3b and GPU memory: the maintainer's questions (answered 2026-10-03, session 4)

1. **Was `GGML_CUDA_ENABLE_UNIFIED_MEMORY=1` set in check 3b?** Yes, in every llama-server run of session 3: check 3b without and with the preload, both re-runs and the U17 smoke runs. It mirrors v1's launcher, which sets it. In this build (b8932) the variable makes `ggml_cuda_device_malloc` call `cudaMallocManaged` instead of `cudaMalloc` (`ggml/src/ggml-cuda/ggml-cuda.cu`); the error text says "cudaMalloc failed" either way. On an integrated GPU such as Orin, llama.cpp reports MemAvailable as free device memory whether or not the variable is set, which is why it showed 3.7–4.3 GB free while allocations failed.
2. **Do allocations beyond MemFree fail with and without it?** **With it: yes**, as far as session 3's load failures suggest, not a general allocator proof. Both loads starting at or below about 1.7 GB MemFree failed; the load at 3.08 GB succeeded. **Without it: not tested.** Session 8 explicitly excludes the historical cache-fill/failure-seeking recipe and server comparison. The replacement bounded API smoke does not cross MemFree and cannot resolve this uncertainty. A separately reviewed safe plan and conservative U18/D-1 load policy remain PENDING; no production policy is approved by portable smoke tests.
3. **Could the wrong libcuda have contributed to the original v1 OOM?** No record of that OOM (time, process or message) exists in the repository, the local notes or the session records. The answer below therefore comes from mechanism, not from evidence about the event:
   - **Not as the direct cause of a GPU allocation failure.** A process that loads the 535 library never creates a CUDA context (`cuInit` 100). TensorRT crashes (exit 139) rather than running out of memory, and llama-server allocates no GPU memory. A CUDA or NvMap out-of-memory error must therefore come from a process that had L4T's library.
   - **Possibly, indirectly.** If v1 was launched without `activate`, llama-server ran on the CPU. That puts full inference load on the CPU and slows v1's loop, and it changes where the memory is. Its effect on whole-device memory was not measured. VmHWM was 2.09 GB on the CPU against 1.86 GB on the GPU, but these are not comparable, because NvMap GPU buffers need not appear in a process's RSS.
   - **A more likely mechanism for a GPU-allocation OOM does not involve the libcuda at all:** allocations beyond MemFree fail even when page cache could be reclaimed (U18). MemFree sits far below MemAvailable after a desktop session or after reading the model files, which is the normal state of this device.
   - Check 9c (PENDING) searches the retained kernel log for OOM kills and NvMap failures, so the original event can be classified as a kernel OOM kill or a GPU allocation failure.

- *Why it changed (session 19, from the code, not a measurement):* a power cut makes the camera reboot, and its boot time on this device has not been measured. After a failed open, the worker waits 1, 2, 4, 8, then 15 s (`reconnect_max_s`) between attempts, and each failing open can take up to 10 s (`open_timeout_s`). Once the camera is up again, the next successful open can therefore be up to about 25 s away. Session 15's 90 s window could end before frames returned. The old command also held the terminal, so the cut and restore times could not be written while it ran. The probe now runs in the background and the shell prints timed prompts and records their times.

  ```bash
      secs = {t(e["utc"]): e for e in r["timeline"]["seconds"]}
      if not secs:
          sys.exit("NO TIMELINE SECONDS: no frame was processed")
      one = timedelta(seconds=1)
      covered = min(secs) <= t(p["p1_nobody_utc"]).replace(microsecond=0) and max(secs) + one >= t(p["end_utc"])
      print("window", min(secs).strftime("%H:%M:%S"), "to", (max(secs) + one).strftime("%H:%M:%S"), "| covers_periods", covered)
      periods = [("p1_nobody", "p1_nobody_utc", "p2_person_utc"), ("p2_person", "p2_person_utc", "p3_nobody_utc"),

      for name, start_key, end_key in periods:
          start, end = t(p[start_key]), t(p[end_key])

          whole = []  # seconds lying wholly between the two prompts; the boundary seconds are left out
          while first + one <= end:

              first += one
          inside = [secs[s] for s in whole if s in secs]
          ids = {tuple(i) for e in inside for i in e["track_ids"]}
          proc = sum(e["processed"] for e in inside)
          with_p = sum(e["frames_with_persons"] for e in inside)

          print(name + ":", "seconds %d/%d" % (len(inside), len(whole)), "| processed", proc,

                "| seconds_with_persons", sum(1 for e in inside if e["frames_with_persons"]),
                "| max_persons", max((e["max_persons"] for e in inside), default=0),
                "max_confirmed", max((e["max_confirmed"] for e in inside), default=0), "| distinct_track_ids", len(ids))
  ' "$D" | tee "$D/summary.txt"
  U="${SENTINEL_RTSP_URL#*://}"; U="${U%%@*}"
  printf 'userinfo_lines=%s lines=%s\n' "$(cat "$D/b.json" "$D/b.err" "$D/prompts.txt" | grep -cF -- "$U")" "$(cat "$D/b.json" "$D/b.err" "$D/prompts.txt" | wc -l)" | tee -a "$D/provenance.txt"
  unset U SENTINEL_RTSP_URL
  ```
  - `seconds n/m`: m whole seconds lie between the two prompts and n of them have processed frames. The boundary seconds are left out, so a late or early step near a prompt does not land in the wrong period.

Since session 37 the probe also records frames with two or more persons (`--multi-person-frames`); nothing else changed:

  ```bash
    T0=$(date +%s%N)
    until_s() { local r=$(( (T0 + $1 * 1000000000 - $(date +%s%N) + 999999) / 1000000 )); [ "$r" -gt 0 ] && sleep "$((r / 1000)).$(printf '%03d' $((r % 1000)))"; true; }
    mark() { echo "$1=$(date -u +%FT%T.%3NZ)" >> "$D/marks.txt"; }
    echo "departure_prompt_utc=$(date -u -d "@$((T0 / 1000000000)).$(printf '%09d' $((T0 % 1000000000)))" +%FT%T.%3NZ)" > "$D/marks.txt"
    printf '\a\n>>> NOW is 0:00. Start your stopwatch and leave the camera view. 3:00 come in and sit here. 4:30 leave. 7:00 come back. <<<\n'
    until_s 60; mark launch_utc; echo "[1:00] probe launched; it stops by itself"

    until_s 270; mark leave_cue_utc; printf '\a\n>>> 4:30 LEAVE the camera view now. Come back when your stopwatch shows 7:00.\n'
    wait "$P"; mark end_utc
  ```

  ```bash
    echo "=== RESULT (detection counts appear only below this line) ==="
    python3 -u -c 'if 1:
        import json, os, sys
        from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
        d = sys.argv[1]
        ALLOWANCE_S, MIN_ABSENT_S, MIN_PRESENT_S = 3, 15, 30
        t = lambda s: datetime.fromisoformat(s.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
        def kv(name):
            out = {}
            for line in open(d + "/" + name):
                line = line.split("#")[0].strip()
                if "=" in line:
                    k, v = line.split("=", 1)
                    out[k.strip()] = v.strip()
            return out
        mt = lambda name: datetime.fromtimestamp(os.stat(d + "/" + name).st_mtime, timezone.utc)
        p, pre, obs, m = kv("provenance.txt"), kv("preconditions.txt"), kv("observations.txt"), kv("marks.txt")
        print("ACCOUNT LOCKED: observations_sha256", p.get("observations_sha256", "?")[:16], "| written", mt("observations.txt").strftime("%H:%M:%S"), "UTC")
        try:
            r = json.load(open(d + "/b.json"))
        except ValueError:
            sys.exit("b.json is not one JSON document: stop and report")
        if r.get("status") in ("refused", "interrupted"):
            sys.exit("STATUS %s %s" % (r.get("status"), r.get("reason")))
        tr, f, u, w, bx = r["tracking"], r["frames"], r["upstream_connections"], r["worker"], r["track_boxes"]
        t0, la, en = t(m["departure_prompt_utc"]), t(m["launch_utc"]), t(m["end_utc"])
        one, a = timedelta(seconds=1), timedelta(seconds=ALLOWANCE_S)
        print("status", r["status"], "| exit_b", p.get("exit_b"), "| captured", f["captured"], "replaced", f["replaced"], "| processed", tr["processed"],
              "skipped", tr["skipped"], "failed", tr["failed"], "| failures", tr["failures"], "error_types", tr["error_types"])
        print("upstream before", u.get("before"), "max", u.get("max"), "| connects", w.get("connects"), "epochs", r["epochs"], "stream_ends", w.get("stream_ends"),
              "| load_s", r["load"]["seconds"], "| timeline dropped", r["timeline"]["dropped_frames"])
        cue = lambda k: "%.1f s" % (t(m[k]) - t0).total_seconds() if k in m else "missing"
        print("machine times after the NOW prompt: launch", cue("launch_utc"), "| enter cue", cue("enter_cue_utc"), "| leave cue", cue("leave_cue_utc"), "| end", cue("end_utc"))
        keys = ["out_of_view_1", "started_walking_in", "in_view_from", "in_view_until", "out_of_view_2", "returned_at"]
        def sw(k):
            try:
                mm, ss = obs.get(k, "").split(":")
                mm, ss = int(mm), int(ss)
            except ValueError:
                return None
            return t0 + timedelta(seconds=mm * 60 + ss) if mm >= 0 and 0 <= ss < 60 else None
        tm = {k: sw(k) for k in keys}
        print("your times (stopwatch, as written):", ", ".join("%s %s" % (k, obs.get(k, "?")) for k in keys))
        ordered = all(tm.values()) and tm["out_of_view_1"] < tm["started_walking_in"] <= tm["in_view_from"] < tm["in_view_until"] <= tm["out_of_view_2"] < tm["returned_at"]
        secs = {t(e["utc"]): e for e in r["timeline"]["seconds"]}
        if not secs:
            sys.exit("NO TIMELINE SECONDS: no frame was processed")
        lo, hi = min(secs), max(secs)
        def whole(start, end):
            out, s = [], start.replace(microsecond=0) + (one if start.microsecond else timedelta(0))
            while s + one <= end:
                if lo <= s <= hi:
                    out.append(s)
                s += one
            return out
        if ordered:
            absent1 = whole(tm["out_of_view_1"] + a, tm["started_walking_in"] - a)
            present = whole(tm["in_view_from"] + a, tm["in_view_until"] - a)
            absent2 = whole(tm["out_of_view_2"] + a, min(tm["returned_at"] - a, en))
        else:
            absent1 = present = absent2 = []
        def zone(name, ks):
            es = [secs.get(k) for k in ks]
            good = [e for e in es if e is not None and e["processed"]]
            withp = sum(1 for e in good if e["frames_with_persons"])
            print("%-13s judged seconds %d | without frames %d | seconds with persons %d | processed %d, with persons %d | max_persons %d | distinct_track_ids %d"
                  % (name + ":", len(ks), len(es) - len(good), withp, sum(e["processed"] for e in good), sum(e["frames_with_persons"] for e in good),
                     max((e["max_persons"] for e in good), default=0), len({tuple(i) for e in good for i in e["track_ids"]})))
            return len(ks), len(es) - len(good), withp
        print("--- counts (reported; judged only through X below, and only if the run is established) ---")
        n1, g1, w1 = zone("absent_before", absent1)
        n2, g2, w2 = zone("present", present)
        n3, g3, w3 = zone("absent_after", absent2)
        judged = {k: "a" for k in absent1 + absent2}
        judged.update({k: "P" for k in present})
        allk = [lo + i * one for i in range(int((hi - lo) / one) + 1)]
        trans = [k for k in allk if k not in judged and k in secs]
        print("not judged (within the allowance of your times, or walking): %d seconds, %d with persons" % (len(trans), sum(1 for k in trans if secs[k]["frames_with_persons"])))
        code = lambda k: "-" if k not in secs else "x" if not secs[k]["processed"] else str(min(secs[k]["max_persons"], 9)) if secs[k]["frames_with_persons"] else "."
        print("per second from", lo.strftime("%H:%M:%S"), "UTC (top: a judged absent, P judged present, blank not judged; bottom: . none, digit most persons, - no frame, x failed only):")
        for i in range(0, len(allk), 60):
            part = allk[i:i + 60]
            print("  +%03ds %s" % (i, "".join(judged.get(k, " ") for k in part)))
            print("        %s" % "".join(code(k) for k in part))
        if ordered:
            pk = [k for k in allk if k in secs and secs[k]["frames_with_persons"]]
            first_in = next((k for k in pk if k >= tm["started_walking_in"] - a), None)
            last_in = next((k for k in reversed(pk) if k < tm["returned_at"]), None)
            rel = lambda k, ref: "none" if k is None else "%+.0f s" % (k - ref).total_seconds()
            print("for description only: first person second from walking in, relative to in_view_from:", rel(first_in, tm["in_view_from"]),
                  "| last person second, relative to out_of_view_2:", rel(last_in, tm["out_of_view_2"]))
        print("track_boxes (normalized, x from the left, y from the top):", len(bx["tracks"]), "of at most", bx["max_tracks"], "| observations_not_summarized", bx["observations_not_summarized"])
        for tb in bx["tracks"]:
            c = tb["confidence"]
            print("  track %d:%d frames %d confirmed %d conf %.3f-%.3f mean %.3f | %s-%s UTC | mean %s union %s" % (tb["track"][0], tb["track"][1],
                  tb["frames"], tb["confirmed_frames"], c["min"], c["max"], c["mean"], tb["first_utc"][11:23], tb["last_utc"][11:23], tb["box_mean"], tb["box_union"]))
        mp = r.get("multi_person_frames")
        if mp is None:
            print("multi-person records: not in b.json (the probe ran without --multi-person-frames)")
        else:
            om = " (%s-%s UTC)" % (mp["omitted_first_utc"][11:23], mp["omitted_last_utc"][11:23]) if mp["samples_omitted"] else ""
            print("multi-person records (diagnostic, not a gate): frames with 2+ persons %d | samples %d of at most %d | samples_omitted %d%s | persons_not_recorded %d"
                  % (mp["frames"], len(mp["samples"]), mp["max_samples"], mp["samples_omitted"], om, mp["persons_not_recorded"]))
            print("  iou and of_smaller describe box geometry only: they cannot show that two boxes are one person, or what a box covers")
            for s in mp["samples"]:
                print("  %s seq %d |" % (s["ingest_utc"][11:23], s["frame"]["frame_seq"]),
                      " ".join("#%d %s %.3f %s" % (q["track_id"], q["status"][:1].upper(), q["confidence"], q["box"]) for q in s["persons"]), "|",
                      " ".join("%d-%d iou %.3f of_smaller %.3f" % (q["tracks"][0], q["tracks"][1], q["iou"], q["of_smaller"]) for q in s["pairs"]))
            two = sum(1 for e in secs.values() if e["max_persons"] >= 2)
            agree = len(mp["samples"]) + mp["samples_omitted"] == mp["frames"] and (mp["frames"] > 0) == (two > 0)
            print("  consistency (descriptive): samples + omitted = frames, and frames > 0 exactly when a second has max_persons >= 2 (%d seconds):" % two, "yes" if agree else "NO")
        pin = "08370639f961d2c67148c19562718ef80527c7085e88d2d923176180f1b98637"
        memfree = p.get("memfree_bytes", "")
        gates = [
            ("P tracked_changes=0", p.get("tracked_changes") == "0"),
            ("P has_timeline_and_stdout_fix=yes", p.get("has_timeline_and_stdout_fix") == "yes"),
            ("P src_config_same_as_3t_outside_diagnostics=yes", p.get("src_config_same_as_3t_outside_diagnostics") == "yes"),
            ("P diagnostic_files_same_as_ee8dc76=yes", p.get("diagnostic_files_same_as_ee8dc76") == "yes"),
            ("P engine_sha256 equals the pin", p.get("engine_sha256") == pin),
            ("P display_manager=inactive", p.get("display_manager") == "inactive"),
            ("P v1_procs=0 and other_camera_clients=0", p.get("v1_procs") == "0" and p.get("other_camera_clients") == "0"),
            ("P memfree_bytes >= 1500000000", memfree.isdigit() and int(memfree) >= 1500000000),
            ("D preconditions.txt last written before the NOW prompt", mt("preconditions.txt") < t0),
            ("D plan_follow_schedule=yes", pre.get("plan_follow_schedule") == "yes"),
            ("T launch at least 60 s after the NOW prompt", la - t0 >= 60 * one),
            ("T enter and leave cues recorded at 3:00 and 4:30 or later", "enter_cue_utc" in m and "leave_cue_utc" in m
                and t(m["enter_cue_utc"]) - t0 >= 180 * one and t(m["leave_cue_utc"]) - t0 >= 270 * one),
            ("E exit_b=0 and status frames_received", p.get("exit_b") == "0" and r["status"] == "frames_received"),
            ("E failed 0, no failures or error types", tr["failed"] == 0 and not tr["failures"] and not tr["error_types"]),
            ("E upstream before 0 and max 1", u.get("before") == 0 and u.get("max") == 1),
            ("E one connection and epoch, no stream end", w.get("connects") == 1 and r["epochs"] == 1 and w.get("stream_ends") == 0),
            ("E timeline dropped 0", r["timeline"]["dropped_frames"] == 0),
            ("E stdout_json=valid", p.get("stdout_json") == "valid"),
            ("E userinfo_lines=0", p.get("userinfo_lines") == "0"),
            ("E probe_procs_after=0", p.get("probe_procs_after") == "0"),
            ("O account written after end_utc and before this summary", en < mt("observations.txt") <= t(p.get("summary_started_utc", "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"))),
            ("O stopwatch_started_at_prompt=yes", obs.get("stopwatch_started_at_prompt") == "yes"),
            ("O all six times given, in order", ordered),
            ("O returned_at not before the probe ended", ordered and tm["returned_at"] + a >= en),
            ("O anyone_else_entered_view=no", obs.get("anyone_else_entered_view") == "no"),
            ("O finished_shown_on_return=yes", obs.get("finished_shown_on_return") == "yes"),
            ("O changes_noticed_on_return=no", obs.get("changes_noticed_on_return") == "no"),
            ("C absent_before: >= %d judged seconds, each with frames" % MIN_ABSENT_S, n1 >= MIN_ABSENT_S and g1 == 0),
            ("C present: >= %d judged seconds, each with frames" % MIN_PRESENT_S, n2 >= MIN_PRESENT_S and g2 == 0),
            ("C absent_after: >= %d judged seconds, each with frames" % MIN_ABSENT_S, n3 >= MIN_ABSENT_S and g3 == 0),
        ]
        detect = [
            ("X absent_before: no person in any judged second", n1 > 0 and w1 == 0),
            ("X present: a person in every judged second", n2 > 0 and w2 == n2 - g2 and g2 == 0),
            ("X absent_after: no person in any judged second", n3 > 0 and w3 == 0),
            ("X max_persons at most 1 in every second of the run", max(e["max_persons"] for e in secs.values()) <= 1),
        ]
        bad = [n for n, ok in gates if not ok]
        xbad = [n for n, ok in detect if not ok]
        print("predeclared gates (P provenance, D declaration, T timing, E execution, O account, C coverage; X detection = 3T conditions):")
        for name, ok in gates:
            print("  %-66s %s" % (name, "met" if ok else "NOT MET"))
        for name, ok in detect:
            print("  %-66s %s" % (name, ("met" if ok else "NOT MET") if not bad else "not evaluated"))
        print("run established (P D T E O C):", "yes" if not bad else "no (%d not met)" % len(bad))
        if bad:
            acct = [n for n in bad if n.startswith("O ")]
            cov = [n for n in bad if n.startswith("C ")]
            print("  not met: %d account (O), %d coverage (C), %d provenance, declaration, timing or execution (P D T E)" % (len(acct), len(cov), len(bad) - len(acct) - len(cov)))
            if acct or (cov and not ordered):
                print("  ACCOUNT, not a detection finding: the account does not meet its gates; an unknown, missing or out-of-order item never meets one%s"
                      % ("; without all six times in order no second is judged, so C fails too" if cov and not ordered else ""))
        print("3T detection conditions (X):", ("met" if not xbad else "NOT met (%d): a detection finding under the declared current conditions" % len(xbad))
              if not bad else "not evaluated: the run is not established; the counts above are reported, not judged")
        print("NOTE: one scene, one person, current conditions; counts, not accuracy; nothing about U23 history; Claude reviews the returned files against the predeclared criteria")
    ' "$D" 2>&1 | tee "$D/summary.txt"
  fi
  ```
- *Stop if:*
  - 3TC-1 fails its expectations, or `URL EMPTY` appears;
  - `exit_b` is not 0, `stdout_json=INVALID`, `failed` > 0, or `probe_procs_after` > 0;
  - `userinfo_lines` > 0: share only the counts, not `b.json` or `b.err`;
  - `REFUSED memfree_below_minimum`: record it; a reboot is the maintainer's decision.

  Then return the files anyway; a stopped run is recorded, not repeated silently.
- *Artifacts:* return `provenance.txt`, `preconditions.txt`, `marks.txt`, `observations.txt`, `account_check.txt`, `summary.txt`, and `b.json` if `userinfo_lines=0`. `b.err` stays local.
- *Acceptance criteria (predeclared; Claude re-checks every gate from the returned files):*
  - **The run is established only if all 30 of these gates are met:**
    - **P provenance (8):** 3TC-1's expected values. Since session 37 the two source comparisons are pinned to `ee8dc76`; the gate count and the expected value (`yes`) are unchanged.
    - **D declaration (2):** `preconditions.txt` last written before `NOW`, with `plan_follow_schedule=yes`. The descriptive items do not gate.
    - **T timing (2):** launch at least 60 s after `NOW`; the 3:00 and 4:30 cues recorded at or after their times.
    - **E execution (8):**
      - `exit_b=0` and `frames_received`;
      - 0 failed, with no failures or error types;
      - upstream before 0 and max 1;
      - one connection and epoch, with no stream end;
      - timeline dropped 0;
      - `stdout_json=valid`, `userinfo_lines=0` and `probe_procs_after=0`.
    - **O account (7):**
      - written after `end_utc` and before the summary, with its hash recorded first;
      - `stopwatch_started_at_prompt=yes`;
      - all six times given (m:ss) and in order;
      - `returned_at` not before the probe ended (3 s allowance);
      - `anyone_else_entered_view=no` and `finished_shown_on_return=yes`;
      - `changes_noticed_on_return=no`. Session 33 required only "not `yes`", which `unknown` met; since session 37 `unknown` meets no gate.
    - **C coverage (3):** at least 15 judged absent seconds before, 30 present and 15 absent after, every judged second with processed frames.
    - **`unknown` never meets a gate:** every gated account item needs a definite value. The descriptive items (`person_like_objects_or_reflections_noticed`, `followed_schedule` and notes) do not gate, as in session 33; the account check lists them when they are `unknown`.
  - **3T's detection conditions (X), evaluated only for an established run:**
    - no person in any judged absent-before or absent-after second;
    - a person in every judged present second;
    - `max_persons` at most 1 in every second of the run.
  - **The intervals:** the 3 s allowance, the judged intervals and what is not judged are defined in the session 33 log, under "How timing is handled". They are unchanged in session 37.
  - **Not criteria:** the account check and the multi-person records are reported, not gated.
- *Interpretation (Claude, after the files are returned; predeclared):*
  - **Established, X met:** 3T's detection conditions are met under the declared current conditions. Claude records step 3's detection-correctness item as met for current conditions. The maintainer confirms before step 3 is marked passed. Nothing more is claimed; see the limitations above.
  - **Established, X not met:** a current-condition finding. Claude reports which condition failed, the per-second pattern, the descriptive offsets, `track_boxes` and the multi-person records (geometry only). Step 3 stays PENDING, and the next step is the maintainer's decision.
  - **Not established:** the failed gates are named, and the counts are reported but not judged. When the failures come from the account (unknown, missing or out-of-order items), they are reported as account gaps, never as detection findings.
- *Run 1 (session 34, USER-SUPPLIED; reviewed in the session 34 log):* `3tc-timed-20261005T153838Z`, after a power cut and reboot. **Not established:** `exit_b=1` and `status no_frames`, with 0 connects and 20 open failures, all `No route to host` at the TCP connection; 8 of 30 gates are not met. 3TC-6 stopped at `NO TIMELINE SECONDS` before printing the gates, so Claude evaluated them from the saved files. 3T's detection conditions are not evaluated. The `exit_b` note under 3TC-4 lists 1 only for a refusal; the probe also exits 1 for `status no_frames` (`cli.py`), as here. No rerun is prepared until CR (below) shows the camera delivering frames.
- *Run 2 (USER-SUPPLIED; reviewed in the session 36 log):* `3tc-timed-20261005T190320Z`, on run 1's boot, after CR showed frames at a changed camera address. Frames were received, and the 20 P, D, T and E gates are met. **Not established:** the account is `unknown` in every field, so 5 O gates and the 3 C gates (no judged seconds) are not met. X is not evaluated. Reported, not judged: tracks 1:1 and 1:5 were published together on 11 frames in 19:39:57–59 UTC (U24). The account is locked and unchanged; the readings were not recorded elsewhere (the maintainer's report).
- *Run 3 (USER-SUPPLIED; reviewed in the session 38 log):* `3tc-timed-20261006T075505Z`, with the revised blocks at `40f28ec`. Boot `64760ff0…`. **Established:** all 30 gates are met. **3T's detection conditions (X) are met** under the declared current conditions:
  - absent before: no person in 109 judged seconds (1,602 frames);
  - present: a person in each of 63 judged seconds (917 of 917 frames);
  - absent after: no person in 81 judged seconds (1,175 frames);
  - `max_persons` at most 1 in all 299 seconds.

  There was one track (1:1, 1,270 frames, 08:01:34.081–08:03:00.723 UTC) and no frame with two or more persons. Claude re-derived every gate twice from the saved files. Step 3's detection-correctness item is recorded as met for current conditions, and the maintainer confirmed step 3 as passed (D53).

**CR. Camera reachability diagnostic (after 3TC run 1; about 2–3 min; no GPU, no detection, no images; numbers only). Prepared in session 34; run twice on 2026-10-05, recorded in session 36 (the runs are at the end of this step).**
- *Purpose:* find where the camera connection fails now, before anyone restarts or reconfigures the camera, router or Jetson. 3TC run 1 recorded `No route to host` on every open attempt (session 34 log). CR separates:
  - the Jetson's own network side: route, interface and gateway;
  - whether anything answers at the camera's configured address: neighbour state, ping and a TCP connection to the RTSP port;
  - only if that port is open, whether frames arrive: a 15 s capture probe, which also reaches authentication and decoding.
- *What it cannot show (predeclared):*
  - it shows the state at CR's time, not at 3TC's. A camera that answers now means the failure is not reproduced, not what caused it;
  - some cameras and routers ignore ping, so a missing ping reply alone settles nothing.

  It never prints the URL, the camera's address or the gateway's address.
- **Before you launch** (D50):

  | | |
  |---|---|
  | Total | About 2–3 min: CR-1 with a short edit, CR-2, then CR-3 runs by itself, about 20 s, or at most about 70 s if the capture probe runs |
  | Position | Anywhere. Nothing judges the scene, so being in view is fine. Look at the camera before CR-1 so you can describe its status light |
  | Timed actions | None |
  | Finish | CR-3 prints the checks and then `CR FINISHED in …` |
  | Nothing under a deadline | Each block waits for you; nothing is timed |

  Before CR-1, do not unplug, restart or reconfigure the camera, router or Jetson until CR-3 has finished. If anything was already done since the 3TC run, write it in `actions_since_3tc`.
- *Prerequisites:* no 3TC run or other camera client running (CR-3 refuses otherwise); all three blocks in one shell (tmux is not needed).
- *CR-1. JETSON: fresh directory, provenance and your declarations (paste as one block, then edit, save and close).* Write what you see now; leave `unknown` or `not_checked` wherever you did not look:
  ```bash
  cd /home/villain8001/sentinel-surveillance
  C=~/sentinel-runs/d1-checklist/cr-reach-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)
  if [ -e "$C" ]; then echo "STOP: $C already exists; do not continue"; C=/nonexistent-stop; else
    mkdir -p -m 700 "$C"
    { echo "utc=$(date -u +%FT%TZ)"; echo "boot_id=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)"; echo "boot_started=$(uptime -s)"
      echo "commit=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"; echo "tracked_changes=$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no | wc -l)"
      echo "other_camera_clients=$(pgrep -fc '[s]urveillance4_1|[l]lama-server|[f]fmpeg|[f]fprobe|[s]entinel\.cli')"; } | tee "$C/provenance.txt"
    printf '%s\n' 'actions_since_3tc=unknown   # in words: anything done to the camera, router, Wi-Fi or Jetson since the 3TC run (unplugged, restarted, app opened), or none' \
      'camera_light_now=unknown   # in words: what the status light on the camera shows now (e.g. solid green, blinking, off), or unknown' \
      'imou_app_shows_camera_online=not_checked   # yes / no / not_checked' \
      'power_cut_also_affected_router=unknown   # yes / no / unknown' \
      'camera_or_router_changed_since_last_good_run=unknown   # moved, reset, re-paired or settings changed since the last run that showed frames: yes / no / unknown; describe in notes' \
      'notes=' > "$C/declared.txt"
    ${EDITOR:-nano} "$C/declared.txt"
  fi
  ```
- *CR-2. JETSON: hidden camera URL (paste this line alone, then the URL, then Enter).* It is the same line as 3TC-3:
  ```bash
  read -rsp 'Camera URL (hidden): ' SENTINEL_RTSP_URL; echo; export SENTINEL_RTSP_URL; [ -n "$SENTINEL_RTSP_URL" ] && echo "url set" || echo "URL EMPTY: stop"
  ```
- *CR-3. JETSON: the checks (paste as one block).* It writes only into `$C`. It reads 3TC run 1's `b.err` only to compare host and port, and prints numbers and states only:
  ```bash
  cd /home/villain8001/sentinel-surveillance
  R3=~/sentinel-runs/d1-checklist/3tc-timed-20261005T153838Z
  if [ ! -d "$C" ] || [ -e "$C/checks.txt" ] || [ ! -s "$C/declared.txt" ] || [ -z "$SENTINEL_RTSP_URL" ]; then echo "STOP: run CR-1 and CR-2 in this shell first"
  elif [ "$(pgrep -fc '[s]urveillance4_1|[l]lama-server|[f]fmpeg|[f]fprobe|[s]entinel\.cli')" -ne 0 ]; then echo "STOP: another camera client is running"
  else
    X0=${SENTINEL_RTSP_URL#*://}; X0=${X0%%/*}; X0=${X0%%\?*}; X=${X0##*@}; H=${X%:*}; P=${X##*:}; [ "$H" = "$X" ] && P=554
    {
      echo "checks_started_utc=$(date -u +%FT%T.%3NZ)"
      if ! [[ $H =~ ^[0-9]{1,3}(\.[0-9]{1,3}){3}$ && $P =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then echo "host_kind=other: stop and report this line"; else
        echo "host_kind=ipv4 port_is_554=$([ "$P" = 554 ] && echo yes || echo no)"
        echo "same_endpoint_as_3tc_lines=$(grep -cF -- "tcp://$H:$P?" "$R3/b.err")   # 20 if the URL host and port match the 3TC run"
        if RT=$(ip -4 route get "$H" 2>/dev/null); then
          DEV=$(sed -nE 's/.* dev ([^ ]+).*/\1/p' <<<"$RT" | head -n 1)
          case "$RT" in *" via "*) echo "route=via_gateway dev=$DEV";; *) echo "route=direct dev=$DEV";; esac
          echo "dev_operstate=$(cat "/sys/class/net/$DEV/operstate" 2>/dev/null || echo unknown) dev_ipv4_addrs=$(ip -4 -o addr show dev "$DEV" | wc -l)"
        else echo "route=none"; fi
        DR=$(ip -4 route show default); G=$(awk '{for (i = 1; i < NF; i++) if ($i == "via") {print $(i + 1); exit}}' <<<"$DR")
        echo "default_routes=$(grep -c . <<<"$DR") default_dev=$(awk '{for (i = 1; i < NF; i++) if ($i == "dev") {print $(i + 1); exit}}' <<<"$DR")"
        if [ -n "$G" ]; then GO=$(timeout 6 ping -n -c 2 -w 4 "$G" 2>&1)
          echo "gateway_ping_replies=$(sed -nE 's/.* ([0-9]+) received.*/\1/p' <<<"$GO" | head -n 1)/2"
        else echo "gateway_ping=not_run (no default route)"; fi
        PO=$(timeout 8 ping -n -c 3 -w 6 "$H" 2>&1); PR=$(sed -nE 's/.* ([0-9]+) received.*/\1/p' <<<"$PO" | head -n 1); PE=$(sed -nE 's/.* \+([0-9]+) errors.*/\1/p' <<<"$PO" | head -n 1)
        echo "camera_ping_replies=${PR:-unknown}/3 camera_ping_unreachable_errors=${PE:-0}"
        T0=$(date +%s%N); TE=$( { timeout 6 bash -c 'exec 3<>"/dev/tcp/$0/$1"' "$H" "$P"; } 2>&1 >/dev/null ); TR=$?; T1=$(date +%s%N)
        case "$TR:$TE" in 0:*) TC=open;; 124:*) TC=timeout;; *"Connection refused"*) TC=refused;; *"No route to host"*) TC=no_route;; *"Network is unreachable"*) TC=net_unreachable;; *) TC=other;; esac
        TMS=$(( (T1 - T0) / 1000000 )); echo "tcp_rtsp_port=$TC tcp_elapsed_s=$((TMS / 1000)).$(printf '%03d' $((TMS % 1000)))"
        NB=$(ip neigh show to "$H"); NS=$(awk '{print $NF}' <<<"$NB" | head -n 1)
        echo "neigh_state=${NS:-none} neigh_lladdr=$(grep -q lladdr <<<"$NB" && echo yes || echo no)"
        if [ "$TC" = open ]; then
          timeout -k 5 35 env PYTHONPATH=src ~/onvif_env/bin/python -m sentinel.cli capture probe config/default.yaml --seconds 15 >"$C/c.json" 2>"$C/c.err"; echo "capture_exit=$?"
          python3 -c 'if 1:
              import json, sys
              r = json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); w, f = r["worker"], r["frames"]
              print("capture_status", r["status"], "| connects", w["connects"], "open_failures", w["open_failures"], "stream_ends", w["stream_ends"],
                    "| captured", f["captured"], "| epochs", r["epochs"], "| sizes", r["native_sizes"], "| upstream max", r["upstream_connections"].get("max"))' "$C/c.json" 2>/dev/null || echo "capture_json=unreadable"
          for k in "No route to host" "Connection refused" "Connection timed out" "401 Unauthorized" "403 Forbidden" "404 Not Found" "Stream timeout triggered" "Invalid data found"; do
            echo "capture_err_lines[$k]=$(grep -c -- "$k" "$C/c.err")"; done
        else echo "capture_probe=not_run (RTSP port not open)"; fi
      fi
      if [[ $X0 == *@* ]]; then U=${X0%@*}; F=$(ls "$C"/*)
        echo "userinfo_lines=$(cat $F | grep -cF -- "$U") userinfo_scanned_lines=$(cat $F | wc -l)"
      else echo "userinfo_check=not_applicable (no user information in the URL)"; fi
      echo "checks_ended_utc=$(date -u +%FT%T.%3NZ)"
    } > "$C/checks.txt" 2>&1
    cat "$C/checks.txt"; unset U F X X0 H P G GO PO PR PE RT DR DEV TE TR TC NB NS SENTINEL_RTSP_URL
    echo "CR FINISHED in $C. Return checks.txt, declared.txt and provenance.txt; c.err stays local."
  fi
  ```
- *Stop if:*
  - `STOP` appears, or `host_kind=other`;
  - `same_endpoint_as_3tc_lines` is not 20: the URL entered now differs from 3TC's. Report it and interpret nothing else;
  - `userinfo_lines` > 0: share only the counts.
- *Artifacts:* return `checks.txt`, `declared.txt` and `provenance.txt`. `c.err` stays local; `c.json` (numbers only) may be returned if `userinfo_lines=0`.
- *Interpretation (Claude, after the files are returned; predeclared; states at CR's time):*
  - `route=none`, `dev_operstate` not `up`, or `dev_ipv4_addrs=0`: the Jetson has no usable route or address toward the camera's address now. The Jetson's network after the reboot is the leading candidate.
  - `route=via_gateway`: the camera's configured address is not on a network the Jetson is attached to now. That alone does not establish that any addressing changed. Reported; the next step is the maintainer's decision. (Corrected in session 36, after the maintainer's correction in session 35. Session 34 had concluded that the Jetson's network, the router's addressing or the camera's address had changed.)
  - `route=direct`, `tcp_rtsp_port=no_route`, `neigh_lladdr=no` and at least 1 gateway reply: the Jetson's link reaches the gateway, and nothing answered at the configured address. `No route to host` does not identify the cause alone. The candidates include the camera (unpowered, not back on the network, or now holding a different address) and the path between the two (the router or access point, client isolation, or a reject rule). `declared.txt` may narrow this; it does not decide it. (Corrected in session 36, after the maintainer's correction in session 35. Session 34 had named only the camera-side causes.) Finding the camera's current address (for example in the router's client list, compared privately) or restarting the camera is the maintainer's decision. CR is then repeated.
  - The same with 0 of 2 gateway replies: the router, or the Jetson's link to it, does not answer either. This is not conclusive alone, since some routers ignore ping.
  - `tcp_rtsp_port=refused`: a device answers at the address, but the RTSP port is closed: the camera's service has not started yet, or another device now holds the address.
  - `tcp_rtsp_port=open`, `capture_status frames_received` and `connects` ≥ 1: the camera delivers frames now. 3TC run 1's failure is not reproduced, and its cause stays undetermined beyond the recorded error. A 3TC rerun can then be prepared.
  - `tcp_rtsp_port=open`, `no_frames` and `401 Unauthorized` lines: the URL's credentials are refused. That is a different failure from 3TC run 1, which never reached authentication.
  - `tcp_rtsp_port=open`, `no_frames` and other error lines: a stream-level problem, reported by its counts.
  - Any other combination (for example `timeout`, `other`, or `no_route` with `neigh_lladdr=yes`) is reported as it is, with no cause inferred.

Nothing answered at the configured address; the corrected branch above applies, and its candidates are not separated.

It tests the new endpoint only; the mechanism of the address change is unknown. Camera 3/3, port `open`, neighbour `REACHABLE`; the 15 s capture received 216 frames with one connection, 640×480, upstream max 1 and no error lines. - *Purpose:* test whether the legacy adapter reports persons in an established empty scene under 3T's conditions (U23). It uses the same engine (SHA-256 pin), thresholds, configuration, camera position and scene. The probe runs 180 s and saves numbers only, no images.
- *What it cannot show:* the camera-to-ingest delay, detection accuracy, or whether the maintainer was visible during 3T.
- *Prerequisites:*

  - Camera position, lighting (lamps, curtains, screens) and objects as during 3T, after dark. Nothing tidied or moved.
  - You launch and wait outside the camera's view: out of the room if possible, and nowhere the camera can see through a doorway, a window or a reflection.
  - Over SSH, run the blocks inside `tmux new -s 3e`, so a dropped connection does not stop the probe.
- *3E-1 versus 3T-1:* 3E-1 records 3T-1's fields, plus the engine hash and whether `src/` and `config/` are unchanged since 3T's commit `4a70ef4`. Its process check is corrected:
  - Every name is bracketed (`[s]urveillance4_1`), so the pattern cannot match its own command text, even inside a wrapper or `bash -c`.
  - v1 gets its own count, `v1_procs`, covering the engine and the dashboard.
  - The 3T run's wrapper used `[s]surveillance4_1`, which matches nothing. 3T-1's unbracketed pattern works when pasted into an interactive terminal, but matches itself when its text is passed to `bash -c` or a script.
- *Washout:* the counted window starts 60 s after launch. This assumes that any delayed (stale) video from before the run has cleared by then. The camera-to-ingest delay is not measured (U3), so the 60 s is an assumption, not a bound.

  ```bash
  cd /home/villain8001/sentinel-surveillance
  if [ ! -d "$D" ] || [ -e "$D/b.json" ] || [ -z "$SENTINEL_RTSP_URL" ]; then echo "STOP: run 3E-1 to 3E-3 in this shell first"; else

      if [ "$E" -lt 60 ]; then M="WASHOUT, not counted: window starts in $((60 - E)) s; stay out of view"
      elif [ "$E" -lt 190 ]; then M="COUNTED WINDOW: stay out of view; probe ends in about $((190 - E)) s"
      else M="COUNTED WINDOW: stay out of view; probe finishing"; fi
      printf '\r[%3d s] %-66s' "$E" "$M"; sleep 1; done
    wait "$P"; echo "end_utc=$(date -u +%FT%T.%3NZ)" >> "$D/marks.txt"; echo; tail -n 1 "$D/provenance.txt"
  fi
  ```

  ```bash
  python3 -m json.tool "$D/b.json" >/dev/null 2>&1 && J=valid || J=INVALID; echo "stdout_json=$J" | tee -a "$D/provenance.txt"
  python3 -u -c 'if 1:
      import json, sys
      from datetime import datetime, timedelta
      d = sys.argv[1]
      t = lambda s: datetime.fromisoformat(s.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
      r = json.load(open(d + "/b.json"))
      if r.get("status") == "refused":
          sys.exit("REFUSED " + str(r.get("reason")))
      m = dict(line.strip().split("=", 1) for line in open(d + "/marks.txt") if "=" in line)
      tr, f, u, b = r["tracking"], r["frames"], r["upstream_connections"], r["backend_ms"]
      print("status", r["status"], "| captured", f["captured"], "replaced", f["replaced"], "| processed", tr["processed"],
            "skipped", tr["skipped"], "failed", tr["failed"], "| failures", tr["failures"], "error_types", tr["error_types"])
      print("upstream", u.get("status"), "max", u.get("max"), "| epochs", r["epochs"], "| load_s", r["load"]["seconds"],
            "| backend_ms p50", b.get("p50"), "p95", b.get("p95"), "| timeline dropped", r["timeline"]["dropped_frames"])
      secs = {t(e["utc"]): e for e in r["timeline"]["seconds"]}
      if not secs:
          sys.exit("NO TIMELINE SECONDS: no frame was processed")
      one = timedelta(seconds=1)
      start = t(m["launch_utc"]) + 60 * one
      first = start.replace(microsecond=0) + (one if start.microsecond else timedelta(0))
      last = max(secs)
      window = [first + i * one for i in range(int((last - first) / one) + 1)] if last >= first else []
      def tally(name, keys):
          es = [secs[k] for k in keys if k in secs]
          proc, withp = sum(e["processed"] for e in es), sum(e["frames_with_persons"] for e in es)
          print(name + ":", "seconds %d/%d" % (len(es), len(keys)), "| processed", proc, "failed", sum(e["failed"] for e in es),
                "| frames_with_persons", withp, "(" + ("%.1f%%" % (100.0 * withp / proc) if proc else "n/a") + " of processed)",
                "| seconds_with_persons", sum(1 for e in es if e["frames_with_persons"]),
                "| max_persons", max((e["max_persons"] for e in es), default=0),
                "max_confirmed", max((e["max_confirmed"] for e in es), default=0),
                "| distinct_track_ids", len({tuple(i) for e in es for i in e["track_ids"]}))
          return proc
      tally("washout_not_counted", sorted(k for k in secs if k < first))
      print("window", first.strftime("%H:%M:%S"), "to", (last + one).strftime("%H:%M:%S"), "UTC, from launch + 60 s (washout assumption)",
            "| covers_window_start", min(secs) <= first)
      print("window_processed_at_least_1500", tally("window", window) >= 1500)
      code = lambda k: "-" if k not in secs else "x" if not secs[k]["processed"] else str(min(secs[k]["max_persons"], 9)) if secs[k]["frames_with_persons"] else "."
      p = "".join(code(k) for k in window)
      print("pattern, one character per window second (. none, digit = most persons in one frame, - no frame, x only failed frames):")
      for i in range(0, len(p), 60):
          print("  +%03ds %s" % (i, p[i:i + 60]))
      runs, i = [], 0
      while i < len(p):
          j = i
          while j < len(p) and p[j].isdigit():
              j += 1
          if j > i:
              ids = sorted({tuple(x) for k in window[i:j] for x in secs[k]["track_ids"]})
              runs.append("+%ds..+%ds (%d s; ids %s)" % (i, j - 1, j - i, " ".join("%d:%d" % x for x in ids)))
          i = max(j, i + 1)
      print("person_runs", len(runs), ":", "; ".join(runs) if runs else "none")
      print("for description only, 3T stay-out periods (session 23): P1 136/187 (72.7%), P3 99/210 (47.1%)")
  ' "$D" 2>&1 | tee "$D/summary.txt"
  if [ -n "$SENTINEL_RTSP_URL" ]; then U="${SENTINEL_RTSP_URL#*://}"; U="${U%%@*}"
    printf 'userinfo_lines=%s lines=%s\n' "$(cat "$D/b.json" "$D/b.err" "$D/marks.txt" | grep -cF -- "$U")" "$(cat "$D/b.json" "$D/b.err" "$D/marks.txt" | wc -l)" | tee -a "$D/provenance.txt"
  else echo "userinfo_check=not_run (URL not set in this shell)" | tee -a "$D/provenance.txt"; fi
  unset U SENTINEL_RTSP_URL
  ```
  - `seconds n/m`: m window seconds, n of them with processed or failed frames.
  - The pattern starts at the window's first second; `+060s` marks 60 s into the window.

- *3ET-4. JETSON: the timed run (paste as one block, then leave at the prompt).* It is the only timed block. It writes the departure prompt, launch and end times to `marks.txt`, bounds the probe at 240 s plus a 5 s kill, and prints no detection count:
  ```bash
  cd /home/villain8001/sentinel-surveillance
  if [ ! -d "$D" ] || [ -e "$D/marks.txt" ] || [ ! -s "$D/preconditions.txt" ] || [ -z "$SENTINEL_RTSP_URL" ]; then echo "STOP: run 3ET-1 to 3ET-3 in this shell first"; else
    echo "departure_prompt_utc=$(date -u +%FT%T.%3NZ)" > "$D/marks.txt"
    printf '\a\n>>> NOW: start your six-minute phone timer and leave the camera view. Come back only when it rings. <<<\n'
    sleep 60 & W=$!; S=$SECONDS
    while kill -0 "$W" 2>/dev/null; do printf '\r[departure] the probe starts in %2d s; leave now   ' "$((60 - SECONDS + S))"; sleep 1; done
    echo; echo "launch_utc=$(date -u +%FT%T.%3NZ)" >> "$D/marks.txt"; echo "[probe] running; it stops by itself after about 3 min"
    timeout -k 5 240 env LD_PRELOAD=/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/nvidia/libcuda.so.1 PYTHONPATH=src ~/onvif_env/bin/python -m sentinel.cli \
      track probe config/default.yaml --engine ~/yolov8n.engine --seconds 180 --box-summary >"$D/b.json" 2>"$D/b.err"
    echo "exit_b=$?" >> "$D/provenance.txt"; echo "end_utc=$(date -u +%FT%T.%3NZ)" >> "$D/marks.txt"
    echo "probe_procs_after=$(pgrep -fc '[s]entinel\.cli track probe')" >> "$D/provenance.txt"
    echo "FINISHED: $(tail -n 2 "$D/provenance.txt" | tr '\n' ' ')(no detection counts are shown). Next: 3ET-5."
  fi
  ```
  - `exit_b`: 0 normally; 124 or 137 if the outer bound stopped the probe; 1 for a refusal. The refusal label is in `tail -n 3 "$D/b.err"`, for example `memfree_below_minimum`.
  - If you come back and `FINISHED` is not on the screen, the run is still going and you are now in view. Wait for `FINISHED`, then write `finished_shown_on_return=no` in 3ET-5. The window will not count.
- *3ET-5. JETSON: your account, written on return, before any count is shown (paste, then edit, save and close).* Words only, `unknown` wherever unsure:
  ```bash
  if ! grep -q '^end_utc=' "$D/marks.txt" 2>/dev/null; then echo "STOP: 3ET-4 has not finished in this shell"; else
    [ -e "$D/observations.txt" ] || printf '%s\n' 'timer_started_at_prompt=unknown   # yes / no / unknown' \
      'out_of_view_before_launch=unknown   # out of the camera view before the 60 s countdown ended: yes / no / unknown' \
      'left_room=unknown   # yes / no / unknown' \
      'stayed_out_until_timer=unknown   # yes / no / unknown' \
      'anyone_else_entered_view=unknown   # anyone, or a pet, as far as you know: yes / no / unknown' \
      'finished_shown_on_return=unknown   # FINISHED was on the screen when you came back: yes / no / unknown' \
      'changes_noticed_on_return=unknown   # lighting, objects, screens or camera: yes / no / unknown; describe in notes' 'notes=' > "$D/observations.txt"
    ${EDITOR:-nano} "$D/observations.txt"
  fi
  ```
- *3ET-6. JETSON: lock the account, run the checks, then show the summary (paste as one block, once).* It refuses to show counts until 3ET-5's file exists. It records that file's SHA-256 and the start time before printing any count. It runs the stdout and userinfo checks (numbers only, never the URL), prints the counts, the window and `track_boxes`, and evaluates the predeclared gates:
  ```bash
  if [ ! -s "$D/observations.txt" ] || ! grep -q '^end_utc=' "$D/marks.txt" 2>/dev/null; then echo "STOP: finish 3ET-4 and write 3ET-5's account first (no counts shown)"; else
    { echo "observations_sha256=$(sha256sum "$D/observations.txt" | cut -c1-64)"; echo "summary_started_utc=$(date -u +%FT%T.%3NZ)"
      python3 -m json.tool "$D/b.json" >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "stdout_json=valid" || echo "stdout_json=INVALID"
      U="${SENTINEL_RTSP_URL#*://}"; U="${U%%@*}"
      if [ -n "$SENTINEL_RTSP_URL" ] && [ -n "$U" ]; then F="$D/b.json $D/b.err $D/marks.txt $D/preconditions.txt $D/observations.txt"
        echo "userinfo_lines=$(cat $F | grep -cF -- "$U")"; echo "userinfo_scanned_lines=$(cat $F | wc -l)"
      else echo "userinfo_check=not_run (URL not set in this shell)"; fi; } | tee -a "$D/provenance.txt"
    unset U F SENTINEL_RTSP_URL
    python3 -u -c 'if 1:
        import json, os, sys
        from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
        d = sys.argv[1]
        t = lambda s: datetime.fromisoformat(s.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
        def kv(name):
            out = {}
            for line in open(d + "/" + name):
                line = line.split("#")[0].strip()
                if "=" in line:
                    k, v = line.split("=", 1)
                    out[k.strip()] = v.strip()
            return out
        mt = lambda name: datetime.fromtimestamp(os.stat(d + "/" + name).st_mtime, timezone.utc)
        p, pre, obs, m = kv("provenance.txt"), kv("preconditions.txt"), kv("observations.txt"), kv("marks.txt")
        print("ACCOUNT LOCKED: observations_sha256", p.get("observations_sha256", "?")[:16], "| written", mt("observations.txt").strftime("%H:%M:%S"), "UTC")
        try:
            r = json.load(open(d + "/b.json"))
        except ValueError:
            sys.exit("b.json is not one JSON document: stop and report")
        if r.get("status") in ("refused", "interrupted"):
            sys.exit("STATUS %s %s" % (r.get("status"), r.get("reason")))
        tr, f, u, w, bx = r["tracking"], r["frames"], r["upstream_connections"], r["worker"], r["track_boxes"]
        dep, la, en = t(m["departure_prompt_utc"]), t(m["launch_utc"]), t(m["end_utc"])
        print("status", r["status"], "| exit_b", p.get("exit_b"), "| captured", f["captured"], "replaced", f["replaced"], "| processed", tr["processed"],
              "skipped", tr["skipped"], "failed", tr["failed"], "| failures", tr["failures"], "error_types", tr["error_types"])
        print("upstream before", u.get("before"), "max", u.get("max"), "| connects", w.get("connects"), "epochs", r["epochs"], "stream_ends", w.get("stream_ends"),
              "| load_s", r["load"]["seconds"], "| timeline dropped", r["timeline"]["dropped_frames"])
        print("launch at departure + %.1f s; end at launch + %.1f s" % ((la - dep).total_seconds(), (en - la).total_seconds()))
        print("persons, whole run: frames_with_persons", r["persons"]["frames_with_persons"], "max_per_frame", r["persons"]["max_per_frame"],
              "track_ids", r["persons"]["track_ids"], "confirmed", r["persons"]["confirmed_track_ids"])
        secs = {t(e["utc"]): e for e in r["timeline"]["seconds"]}
        if not secs:
            sys.exit("NO TIMELINE SECONDS: no frame was processed")
        one = timedelta(seconds=1)
        start = la + 60 * one
        first = start.replace(microsecond=0) + (one if start.microsecond else timedelta(0))
        last = max(secs)
        window = [first + i * one for i in range(int((last - first) / one) + 1)] if last >= first else []
        def tally(name, keys):
            es = [secs[k] for k in keys if k in secs]
            proc, withp = sum(e["processed"] for e in es), sum(e["frames_with_persons"] for e in es)
            print(name + ":", "seconds %d/%d" % (len(es), len(keys)), "| processed", proc, "failed", sum(e["failed"] for e in es),
                  "| frames_with_persons", withp, "(" + ("%.1f%%" % (100.0 * withp / proc) if proc else "n/a") + " of processed)",
                  "| seconds_with_persons", sum(1 for e in es if e["frames_with_persons"]),
                  "| max_persons", max((e["max_persons"] for e in es), default=0), "max_confirmed", max((e["max_confirmed"] for e in es), default=0),
                  "| distinct_track_ids", len({tuple(i) for e in es for i in e["track_ids"]}))
            return proc
        tally("washout_not_counted", sorted(k for k in secs if k < first))
        print("window", first.strftime("%H:%M:%S"), "to", (last + one).strftime("%H:%M:%S"), "UTC, from launch + 60 s (washout assumption)")
        wproc = tally("window", window)
        code = lambda k: "-" if k not in secs else "x" if not secs[k]["processed"] else str(min(secs[k]["max_persons"], 9)) if secs[k]["frames_with_persons"] else "."
        pat = "".join(code(k) for k in window)
        print("pattern, one character per window second (. none, digit = most persons in one frame, - no frame, x only failed frames):")
        for i in range(0, len(pat), 60):
            print("  +%03ds %s" % (i, pat[i:i + 60]))
        print("track_boxes (normalized, x from the left, y from the top):", len(bx["tracks"]), "of at most", bx["max_tracks"],
              "| observations_not_summarized", bx["observations_not_summarized"])
        for tb in bx["tracks"]:
            c = tb["confidence"]
            print("  track %d:%d frames %d confirmed %d conf %.3f-%.3f mean %.3f | %s-%s UTC | mean %s union %s" % (tb["track"][0], tb["track"][1],
                  tb["frames"], tb["confirmed_frames"], c["min"], c["max"], c["mean"], tb["first_utc"][11:23], tb["last_utc"][11:23], tb["box_mean"], tb["box_union"]))
        pin = "08370639f961d2c67148c19562718ef80527c7085e88d2d923176180f1b98637"
        memfree = p.get("memfree_bytes", "")
        gates = [
            ("P tracked_changes=0", p.get("tracked_changes") == "0"),
            ("P has_timeline_and_stdout_fix=yes", p.get("has_timeline_and_stdout_fix") == "yes"),
            ("P src_config_same_as_3t_outside_d49=yes", p.get("src_config_same_as_3t_outside_d49") == "yes"),
            ("P d49_files_same_as_92bce43=yes", p.get("d49_files_same_as_92bce43") == "yes"),
            ("P engine_sha256 equals the pin", p.get("engine_sha256") == pin),
            ("P display_manager=inactive", p.get("display_manager") == "inactive"),
            ("P v1_procs=0 and other_camera_clients=0", p.get("v1_procs") == "0" and p.get("other_camera_clients") == "0"),
            ("P memfree_bytes >= 1500000000", memfree.isdigit() and int(memfree) >= 1500000000),
            ("D preconditions.txt last written before the departure prompt", mt("preconditions.txt") < dep),
            ("D plan_out_of_view_six_minutes=yes", pre.get("plan_out_of_view_six_minutes") == "yes"),
            ("T launch at least 60 s after the departure prompt", la - dep >= 60 * one),
            ("E exit_b=0 and status frames_received", p.get("exit_b") == "0" and r["status"] == "frames_received"),
            ("E failed 0, no failures or error types", tr["failed"] == 0 and not tr["failures"] and not tr["error_types"]),
            ("E upstream before 0 and max 1", u.get("before") == 0 and u.get("max") == 1),
            ("E one connection and epoch, no stream end", w.get("connects") == 1 and r["epochs"] == 1 and w.get("stream_ends") == 0),
            ("E timeline dropped 0", r["timeline"]["dropped_frames"] == 0),
            ("E stdout_json=valid", p.get("stdout_json") == "valid"),
            ("E userinfo_lines=0", p.get("userinfo_lines") == "0"),
            ("E probe_procs_after=0", p.get("probe_procs_after") == "0"),
            ("W window covers its start", min(secs) <= first),
            ("W window processed >= 1500", wproc >= 1500),
            ("O account written after end_utc and before this summary", en < mt("observations.txt") <= t(p.get("summary_started_utc", "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"))),
            ("O out_of_view_before_launch=yes", obs.get("out_of_view_before_launch") == "yes"),
            ("O stayed_out_until_timer=yes", obs.get("stayed_out_until_timer") == "yes"),
            ("O anyone_else_entered_view=no", obs.get("anyone_else_entered_view") == "no"),
            ("O finished_shown_on_return=yes", obs.get("finished_shown_on_return") == "yes"),
            ("O changes_noticed_on_return is not yes", obs.get("changes_noticed_on_return") != "yes"),
        ]
        print("predeclared gates (P provenance, D declaration, T timing, E execution, W window, O account):")
        for name, ok in gates:
            print("  %-62s %s" % (name, "met" if ok else "NOT MET"))
        bad = [name for name, ok in gates if not ok]
        print("current-condition empty-scene window ESTABLISHED:", "yes" if not bad else "no (%d not met)" % len(bad))
        print("NOTE: counts, not accuracy; no claim about earlier scenes or U23; Claude interprets the returned files against the predeclared criteria")
    ' "$D" 2>&1 | tee "$D/summary.txt"
  fi
  ```
- *Stop if:*
  - 3ET-1 fails its expectations, or `URL EMPTY` appears;
  - `exit_b` is not 0, `stdout_json=INVALID`, `failed` > 0, or `probe_procs_after` > 0;
  - `userinfo_lines` > 0: share only the counts, not `b.json` or `b.err`;
  - `REFUSED memfree_below_minimum`: record it; a reboot is the maintainer's decision.

  Then return the files anyway; a stopped run is recorded, not repeated silently.
- *Artifacts:* return `provenance.txt`, `preconditions.txt`, `marks.txt`, `observations.txt`, `summary.txt`, and `b.json` if `userinfo_lines=0`. `b.err` stays local.
- *Acceptance criteria (predeclared; all 27 gates in 3ET-6 must be met for an established current-condition empty-scene window):*
  - **P provenance:** 3ET-1's expected values.
  - **D declaration:** `preconditions.txt` last written before `departure_prompt_utc`, with `plan_out_of_view_six_minutes=yes`. The descriptive items do not gate.
  - **T timing:** launch at least 60 s after the prompt.
  - **E execution:**
    - `exit_b=0` and `frames_received`;
    - 0 failed, with no failures or error types;
    - upstream before 0 and max 1;
    - one connection and epoch, with no stream end;
    - timeline dropped 0;
    - `stdout_json=valid`, `userinfo_lines=0` and `probe_procs_after=0`.
  - **W window:** from launch + 60 s (the washout assumption), covering its start, with at least 1,500 processed frames.
  - **O account:**
    - written after `end_utc` and before the summary started, with its hash recorded first;
    - `out_of_view_before_launch=yes`, `stayed_out_until_timer=yes`, `anyone_else_entered_view=no` and `finished_shown_on_return=yes`;
    - `changes_noticed_on_return` not `yes`.

  Claude re-checks every gate from the returned files. The hash shows whether the account changed after the summary.
- *Interpretation (Claude, after the files are returned; predeclared; no acceptance threshold):*
  - **Established window, zero persons:** under the declared current conditions, the adapter reported no person in an empty scene for the window's frames. Nothing more: see the limitations above. Whether this settles step 3's detection correctness is the maintainer's decision; no predeclared rule makes it do so.
  - **Established window, persons reported:** evidence of erroneous person reports under current conditions. It is subject to the stale-video uncertainty, since video delayed by more than 60 s would fall inside the window. If `left_room=no`, a reflection or partial view of the operator is not excluded. Claude reports:
    - the counts and rate;
    - the seconds with persons, the most persons and the distinct track IDs;
    - the temporal pattern;
    - `track_boxes` positions.

    None of these is a rate threshold.
  - **Not established:** the counts are reported and the failed gates named, but not used as empty-scene evidence.
- *Optional, no hardware: the retrospective userinfo count for `3e-timer-mxlIc1hs`.* It closes that run's last recoverable gap. It prints counts only and writes nothing into the run directory. Paste it, then the URL and Enter, and report the printed line. It is recorded as a retrospective check, not as part of that run:
  ```bash
  D=~/sentinel-runs/d1-checklist/3e-timer-mxlIc1hs; read -rsp 'Camera URL (hidden): ' X; echo; U="${X#*://}"; U="${U%%@*}"; unset X
  if [ -n "$U" ]; then F="$D/b.json $D/b.err $D/marks.txt $D/provenance.txt $D/preconditions.txt"
    echo "retro_userinfo_lines=$(cat $F | grep -cF -- "$U") scanned_lines=$(cat $F | wc -l) checked_utc=$(date -u +%FT%TZ)"; else echo "URL EMPTY: nothing checked"; fi; unset U F
  ```

**3P. Operator-only live preview (D49; P1 from session 25; diagnostic, not a measurement, so no D37 drop; GPU; about 10 min in all, of which 3P-4 runs about 195 s). Prepared in session 26; two attempts, neither viewed (sessions 27 and 28, recorded at the end of this step). With a viewer it needs the Mac outside the view, which the stated setup rules out (session 28), so 3V is the attended alternative. 3V verified viewer delivery (session 29); 3P's empty-scene purpose stays PENDING.**
- *Purpose:* see where the boxes the track probe counts are (U23): on the frames they came from, with track ID, confidence and C/T, while you stay outside the camera's view. `--box-summary` also records each track's box positions as numbers.
- *What it cannot show:* accuracy or a rate, what happened in 3T or 3E, detections the adapter drops, or the camera-to-ingest delay. The preview adds its own small, unmeasured latency.
- *Not a baseline:* this run's timings, CPU and memory include the preview's work (`preview.note`).
- *Prerequisites:*
  - The same as 3E: headless, MemFree ≥ 1,500,000,000 B, no v1, llama-server or other camera client, and the scene as in 3E.
  - The Jetson blocks run inside `tmux new -s 3p`.
  - You and the Mac stay outside the camera's view from 3P-4 to FINISHED.
  - Nothing is saved but numbers. Describe what you see in words; no screenshots are needed.
- *Order:* M1 → 3P-1, 3P-2, 3P-3 → M2 → 3P-4, then open the URL on the Mac → FINISHED → 3P-5, 3P-6 → M3.
- *M1. On the Mac, before 3P-3 (terminal 1): a token and the browser URL. The token goes to the clipboard for 3P-3:*
  ```bash
  TOKEN=$(openssl rand -base64 24 | tr '+/' '-_' | tr -d '=\n'); printf '%s' "$TOKEN" | pbcopy
  echo "Token copied. Browser URL for 3P-4: http://127.0.0.1:18091/$TOKEN/"
  ```
  After pasting the token in 3P-3, clear the clipboard: `pbcopy </dev/null`.
- *M2. On the Mac, before 3P-4 (terminal 2; leave it running until FINISHED):*
  ```bash

  ssh -N -o ExitOnForwardFailure=yes -L 18091:127.0.0.1:18091 "$JETSON"
  ```
  - The local port must be 18091: the preview checks the Host header.
  - If ssh reports the port in use, something on the Mac already holds 18091 (for example a VS Code forward). Stop it, then retry.

- *3P-1. Fresh directory and recorded preconditions (paste as one block):*

- *3P-4. The timed run (paste as one block from outside the camera view). TOTAL about 195 s (3 min 15 s): model load about 10 s, 180 s of preview, then shutdown. The countdown ends with FINISHED:*
  ```bash
  cd /home/villain8001/sentinel-surveillance
  if [ ! -d "$D" ] || [ -e "$D/b.json" ] || [ -z "$SENTINEL_RTSP_URL" ] || [ -z "$SENTINEL_PREVIEW_TOKEN" ]; then echo "STOP: run 3P-1 to 3P-3 in this shell first"; else
    T=195; echo "TOTAL: about $T s (3 min 15 s). Open the preview URL on the Mac now; frames start after the model load."
    ( LD_PRELOAD=/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/nvidia/libcuda.so.1 PYTHONPATH=src ~/onvif_env/bin/python -m sentinel.cli \
        track probe config/default.yaml --engine ~/yolov8n.engine --seconds 180 --preview --box-summary >"$D/b.json" 2>"$D/b.err"
      echo "exit_b=$?" >> "$D/provenance.txt" ) &
    P=$!; echo "launch_utc=$(date -u +%FT%T.%3NZ)" > "$D/marks.txt"; S=$SECONDS
    while kill -0 "$P" 2>/dev/null; do E=$((SECONDS - S)); L=$((T - E))
      if [ "$E" -lt 12 ]; then M="loading the model; the page waits for frames"
      elif [ "$L" -gt 0 ]; then M="PREVIEW LIVE: watch from outside the camera view"
      else M="finishing (past the estimate)"; L=0; fi
      printf '\r[%3d s left of %d s TOTAL] %-50s' "$L" "$T" "$M"; sleep 1; done
    wait "$P"; echo "end_utc=$(date -u +%FT%T.%3NZ)" >> "$D/marks.txt"; echo; tail -n 1 "$D/provenance.txt"; echo "FINISHED"
  fi
  ```

  ```bash
  cd /home/villain8001/sentinel-surveillance
  if [ ! -d "$D" ] || [ -e "$D/b.json" ] || [ -z "$SENTINEL_RTSP_URL" ] || [ -z "$SENTINEL_PREVIEW_TOKEN" ]; then echo "STOP: run 3V-1 to 3V-3 in this shell first"; else
    echo "TOTAL about 70 s (model load about 5-10 s, 60 s of preview, then shutdown)."
    echo ">>> NOW paste M3 in Mac terminal 1. Stay at the Mac, visible to the camera. <<<"
    ( LD_PRELOAD=/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/nvidia/libcuda.so.1 PYTHONPATH=src ~/onvif_env/bin/python -m sentinel.cli \
        track probe config/default.yaml --engine ~/yolov8n.engine --seconds 60 --preview --box-summary >"$D/b.json" 2>"$D/b.err"
      echo "exit_b=$?" >> "$D/provenance.txt" ) &
    P=$!; echo "launch_utc=$(date -u +%FT%T.%3NZ)" > "$D/marks.txt"; S=$SECONDS; V=waiting; N=0
    while kill -0 "$P" 2>/dev/null; do E=$((SECONDS - S))
      if [ "$V" = waiting ]; then
        if [ "$(ss -Htn state established '( sport = :18091 )' | wc -l)" -gt 0 ]; then N=$((N + 1)); else N=0; fi
        if [ "$N" -ge 2 ]; then V=connected; echo; echo "viewer_connected_utc=$(date -u +%FT%T.%3NZ)" | tee -a "$D/marks.txt"
        elif [ "$E" -ge 30 ]; then V=none; echo; echo "no_viewer_stop_utc=$(date -u +%FT%T.%3NZ)" | tee -a "$D/marks.txt"
          echo "NO VIEWER CONNECTED by launch + 30 s: stopping the probe now (exit_b=130 expected). See 'If the page cannot connect'."
          pkill -INT -f '[s]entinel\.cli track probe'; fi

      case "$V" in waiting) M="viewer: waiting for the browser (probe stops at 30 s without one)";;
        connected) M="viewer: CONNECTED - watch the boxes, stay visible";; *) M="viewer: NONE - stopping";; esac
      printf '\r[%3d s of about 70 s] %-66s' "$E" "$M"; sleep 1; done
    wait "$P"; echo "end_utc=$(date -u +%FT%T.%3NZ)" >> "$D/marks.txt"; echo; tail -n 1 "$D/provenance.txt"; echo "FINISHED"
  fi
  ```

  ```bash
            "render_count", p["render_ms"]["count"], "render_failures", p["render_failures"])
      print("  refused_host", q["refused_host"], "not_found", q["not_found"], "refused_method", q["refused_method"],
            "handler_errors", q["handler_errors"], "| refused_busy", v["refused_busy"], "disconnected", v["disconnected"],
            "write_timeouts", v["write_timeouts"], "ended_by_stop", v["ended_by_stop"])
      print("preview: ended_by", p["ended_by"], "closed", p["closed"], "handlers_open", p["handlers_open"],
            "render_ms", p["render_ms"], "updates", p["updates"])
      print("  NOTE:", p["note"])
      print("track_boxes (normalized, x from the left, y from the top):", len(b["tracks"]), "of at most", b["max_tracks"],
            "| observations_not_summarized", b["observations_not_summarized"])
      for t in b["tracks"]:
          c = t["confidence"]
          print("  track %d:%d frames %d confirmed %d conf %.3f-%.3f mean %.3f | %s-%s UTC" % (t["track"][0], t["track"][1],
                t["frames"], t["confirmed_frames"], c["min"], c["max"], c["mean"], t["first_utc"][11:23], t["last_utc"][11:23]))
          print("    first %s last %s mean %s union %s" % (t["box_first"], t["box_last"], t["box_mean"], t["box_union"]))
  ' "$D" 2>&1 | tee "$D/summary.txt"
  ```

### Other pending hardware checks (outside this checklist)

```bash
# 2. Rest of check 2: frame rate, bitrate and keyframe spacing of both profiles, 60 s of
#    video packets each (no decode). The main stream's codec, size and rate are recorded.
#    Needs SENTINEL_RTSP_URL (substream) exported; prints variable names, never URLs.
MAIN_URL="${SENTINEL_RTSP_URL/subtype=1/subtype=0}"
for URL_VAR in MAIN_URL SENTINEL_RTSP_URL; do
  echo "== $URL_VAR"
  ffprobe -v error -rtsp_transport tcp -select_streams v:0 -read_intervals %+60 \
    -show_entries packet=pts_time,size,flags -of csv=p=0 "${!URL_VAR}" 2>/dev/null \
  | awk -F, '{n++; b+=$2; if(n==1)t0=$1; t1=$1; if($3~/K/){k++; if(kp!="")g=g" "sprintf("%.2f",$1-kp); kp=$1}}
      END {d=t1-t0; printf "packets=%d span_s=%.2f fps=%.2f kbit_s=%.0f keyframes=%d gop_s=%s\n", n, d, (n-1)/d, b*8/d/1000, k, g}'
done
unset MAIN_URL
#    Also note from the camera's web/app settings: model, firmware, and the frame-rate
#    choices offered for each profile (after the demo).

# 7. DEFERRED with V2-05 proper (D24); not needed for the Oct 20 demo.
gst-inspect-1.0 nvv4l2decoder | sed -n '1,25p'
gst-inspect-1.0 nvvidconv | sed -n '1,25p'
#    Hardware-decode smoke test on the substream, 30 s (in a second terminal: tegrastats --interval 1000).
timeout -s INT 30 gst-launch-1.0 -e rtspsrc location="$SENTINEL_RTSP_URL" protocols=tcp latency=200 \
  ! rtph264depay ! h264parse ! nvv4l2decoder ! nvvidconv ! 'video/x-raw,format=BGRx' \
  ! fpsdisplaysink video-sink=fakesink text-overlay=false sync=false -v 2>&1 \
  | sed -E 's#rtsp://[^[:space:]]+#rtsp://<redacted>#g' | grep -E 'last-message|ERROR|WARN' | tail -4
```
